description.ja: ＭＧ 1/100 ヘビーアームズ改 ＥＷ版、ファン待望のＭＧシリーズで登場！！
description.en: MG 1/100 Heavy Arms Kai EW version is now available in the long-awaited MG series! !

description.ja: 戦　場　の　道　化　師　、再　び　－－－－－－－－
description.en: Battlefield Jester, again －－－－－－－－

description.en: Trowa Barton's Heavy Arms MS, Heavy Arms Modification, Appears!

description.ja: 『新機動戦記ガンダムＷ Ｅｎｄｌｅｓｓ Ｗａｌｔｚ』より、ガンダムヘビーアームズ改 ＥＷをマスターグレードシリーズで商品化。
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam W Endless Waltz", Gundam Heavy Arms Kai EW is commercialized in the Master Grade Series.

description.ja: 全身に様々な火器を内蔵する「歩く火薬庫」とも言うべきその姿を、新規武器と成形色で徹底再現！
description.en: Its appearance, which can be called a "walking powder magazine" with various firearms built into its body, has been thoroughly reproduced with new weapons and molding colors!

description.ja: ● 特徴的な武装を新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the characteristic weapons with new modeling!

description.ja: 両腕に装備可能な大型のダブルガトリングガンや、胸部ハッチの中に搭載された４門の胸部バルカンなど、
description.en: A large double Gatling gun that can be equipped on both arms, and a four-gun chest vulcan mounted in the chest hatch.

description.ja: 「ガンダムヘビーアームズ改 ＥＷ」の特徴的な武器を、ＭＧ準拠のディテール豊かな新規造形で再現。
description.en: The characteristic weapon of "Gundam Heavy Arms Kai EW" is reproduced with a new model with rich details in accordance with MG.

description.ja: 〔　ダブルガトリングガン　〕
description.en: [Double Gatling Gun]

description.ja: 「ガンダムヘビーアームズ」のメインウエポン・ビームガトリングガンが２連となり、
description.en: "Gundam Heavy Arms" main weapon beam gatling gun becomes double,

description.ja: さらに攻撃力が増した強力な火器。両手にそれぞれのダブルガトリングガンを装備可能。
description.en: A powerful firearm with even more attack power. Each hand can be equipped with a double gatling gun.

description.ja: また、バックパックにマウントし携行装備可能。
description.en: It can also be carried by mounting it on a backpack.

description.ja: 〔　胸部バルカン　〕
description.en: [Thorax Vulcan]

description.ja: 胸部ハッチ内部には、「ガンダムヘビーアームズ」の２門から、４門に増加された胸部バルカンを搭載。
description.en: Inside the chest hatch is equipped with ``Gundam Heavy Arms'' chest vulcans, which have been increased from 2 to 4 guns.

description.ja: フルハッチオープンでの全弾発射時には、より威力が増す。
description.en: The power increases when firing all bullets with the hatch fully open.

description.ja: ● ピエロマスクが付属！
description.en: ● A clown mask is included!

description.ja: パイロット・トロワを象徴する、ＭＳの顔に装着するピエロのマスクを新規パーツで再現。
description.en: The clown mask worn on the MS's face, which symbolizes Pilot Trois, is reproduced with new parts.

description.ja: ● 新規のフィギュア付属！
description.en: ● New figure included!

description.ja: マリーメイア軍の制服姿のトロワ・バートンの立ち姿の同スケールフィギュアが、新規造形で付属。
description.en: The same scale figure of Trowa Barton standing in the uniform of the Mariemaia army is included with a new model.

description.ja: 加え、コックピット（座り）ポーズの同スケールフィギュアも付属。
description.en: In addition, the same Scale figure in a cockpit (sitting) pose is also included.

description.ja: ● 新規デザインの水転写デカール付属！
description.en: ● Newly designed water transfer decal included!
